title: Commercial client sends an Instant Payment (RTP) via CitiBusiness Online (sketch)
customer_goal: Pay a supplier with immediate finality

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.action: Select Instant Payments (RTP) and enter beneficiary/amount

moments.title: Approval per entitlements
moments.frontstage: Treasury Solutions Guide Sec. 1.7: 'Approval requirements can be established for each User's initiated transaction when setting up each User's account entitlements.' Sec. 11 does not state Instant-Payment-specific approval rules; insufficient funds cause the payment to 'reject upon initiation'; payments over the client's single/daily/weekly/monthly limits (Citi's April 2024 guide states a $1,000,000 per-transaction RTP limit (the network cap has since risen; Citi may set lower client limits)) may be blocked. General CBOL entitlement rule only, so the step stays INFERRED for Instant Payments specifically.

moments.title: Sender cannot recall: 'Instant Payments sent through RTP are…
moments.action: Sender cannot recall: 'Instant Payments sent through RTP are irrevocable and cannot be reversed by the sender'; client asks its Citi Service Representative to send a Request for Return of Funds; return 'is entirely voluntary' for the recipient and Citi 'cannot guarantee that funds will be returned in whole or in part'

touchpoints.screen: Citi Service Representative (not self-service in CBOL)

moments.title: Business user calls CitiBusiness Online Customer Service 1-800-285-1709…
moments.customer_action: Business user calls CitiBusiness Online Customer Service 1-800-285-1709 option 1 (Technical Support) or option 2 (Cash Management: ACH, Positive Pay, Lockbox), or sends a secure message via Customer Service > Send Message to Customer Service
moments.action: Business user calls CitiBusiness Online Customer Service 1-800-285-1709 option 1 (Technical Support) or option 2 (Cash Management: ACH, Positive Pay, Lockbox), or sends a secure message via Customer Service > Send Message to Customer Service
moments.frontstage: Message gets a reference number; reply inside CBOL within two business days; phone hours Mon-Fri 7 AM-11 PM ET, Sat-Sun 9 AM-5:30 PM ET

status_tracking.where: CitiBusiness Online (near-immediate success/failure status) and the client's chosen notification settings
states: receiving bank unable to process within RTP timing

exceptions.trigger: Insufficient funds or limit exceeded at initiation
exceptions.customer_experience: Payment rejects upon initiation (insufficient funds) or is blocked (over single-transaction $1,000,000 per-transaction RTP limit stated in Citi's April 2024 guide (the network cap has since risen; Citi may set lower client limits) or client daily/weekly/monthly limits)
exceptions.bank_handling: Citi rejects/blocks; may set lower limits and adjust them with notice
exceptions.resolution: Fund the account or reduce the amount
